import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long N, K;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static List<List<List<List<Long>>>> S, A, P;
    static List<List<Long>> Res, Aux;
    static List<Long> Power;

    static void copyMat(List<List<Long>> dest, List<List<Long>> src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < dest.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dest.get(i).size(); ++j) {
                dest.get(i).set(j, src.get(i).get(j));
            }
        }
    }

    static void addMod(long[] a, int idx, long b) {
        a[idx] = (a[idx] + b) % MOD;
    }

    static void matMul(List<List<Long>> mat1, List<List<Long>> mat2, List<List<Long>> res, int n, int m, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; ++j) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                    long product = (mat1.get(i).get(k) * mat2.get(k).get(j)) % MOD;
                    sum = (sum + product) % MOD;
                }
                res.get(i).set(j, sum);
            }
        }
    }

    static void precomputeA() {
        for (long x = 0; x < K; ++x) {
            for (long i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
                A.get(0).get((int)x).get((int)i).set((int)i, 1L);
            }
            for (long j = 0; j < K + 1; ++j) {
                A.get(0).get((int)x).get((int)j).set((int)x, 1L);
            }
        }

        copyMat(P.get(0).get(0), A.get(0).get(0));
        copyMat(S.get(0).get((int)(K - 1)), A.get(0).get((int)(K - 1)));

        for (long x = 1; x < K; ++x) {
            matMul(P.get(0).get((int)(x - 1)), A.get(0).get((int)x), P.get(0).get((int)x), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1));
        }

        for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; --x) {
            matMul(A.get(0).get((int)x), S.get(0).get((int)(x + 1)), S.get(0).get((int)x), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1));
        }

        long multiplier = 1;
        int level = 0;
        while (multiplier <= N / K) {
            for (long x = 0; x < K; ++x) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    copyMat(A.get(level).get((int)x), S.get(level - 1).get((int)x));
                    matMul(A.get(level).get((int)x), P.get(level - 1).get((int)(x - 1)), Aux, (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1));
                    copyMat(A.get(level).get((int)x), Aux);
                } else {
                    copyMat(A.get(level).get((int)x), S.get(level - 1).get((int)x));
                }
            }
            copyMat(P.get(level).get(0), A.get(level).get(0));
            copyMat(S.get(level).get((int)(K - 1)), A.get(level).get((int)(K - 1)));

            for (long x = 1; x < K; ++x) {
                matMul(P.get(level).get((int)(x - 1)), A.get(level).get((int)x), P.get(level).get((int)x), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1));
            }

            for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; --x) {
                matMul(A.get(level).get((int)x), S.get(level).get((int)(x + 1)), S.get(level).get((int)x), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1));
            }

            if (multiplier > N / K / K) break;
            multiplier *= K;
            ++level;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        Power = new ArrayList<>();
        Power.add(1L);
        while (Power.get(Power.size() - 1) <= N / K) {
            Power.add(Power.get(Power.size() - 1) * K);
        }

        int levels = Power.size() - 1;

        S = new ArrayList<>();
        A = new ArrayList<>();
        P = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= levels; ++i) {
            List<List<List<Long>>> levelS = new ArrayList<>();
            List<List<List<Long>>> levelA = new ArrayList<>();
            List<List<List<Long>>> levelP = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                List<List<Long>> rowS = new ArrayList<>();
                List<List<Long>> rowA = new ArrayList<>();
                List<List<Long>> rowP = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < K + 1; ++k) {
                    rowS.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(K + 1, 0L)));
                    rowA.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(K + 1, 0L)));
                    rowP.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(K + 1, 0L)));
                }
                levelS.add(rowS);
                levelA.add(rowA);
                levelP.add(rowP);
            }
            S.add(levelS);
            A.add(levelA);
            P.add(levelP);
        }

        Res = new ArrayList<>();
        Aux = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            Res.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(K + 1, 0L)));
            Aux.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(K + 1, 0L)));
        }

        precomputeA();

        long remaining = N;
        int digitIndex = 0;
        Res.get(0).set(K, 1L);

        for (int p = levels; p >= 0; --p) {
            while (Power.get(p) <= remaining) {
                matMul(Res, A.get(p).get(digitIndex), Aux, (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1), (int)(K + 1));
                copyMat(Res, Aux);
                digitIndex = (digitIndex + 1) % (int)K;
                remaining -= Power.get(p);
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
            answer = (answer + Res.get(0).get(i)) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
